anti_regression_rule: Never infer or restore a 163-player live universe from stale prompts, historical workbooks, filenames, prior assistant text, or legacy checkpoints. Any live current-news sweep, board QA, synchronization, or current-outlook pass must resolve the active universe from MODEL_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.json and must fail closed unless the loaded unique-player count equals 166 or the source of truth is intentionally changed by an explicit canonical migration.
news_layer_rule: Current news/outlooks are dynamic and separate from frozen static Player Evaluations. News may include dated injury, recovery, practice, role, depth-chart, transaction, suspension/off-field availability, connected-player context, recent game stats, and next opponent after games begin.
static_evaluation_rule: Player Evaluations remain frozen baseline records and must not be rewritten by ongoing news.
failure_policy: Report ingestion failures and stale/unverified players explicitly; do not silently carry them as current.
